stories.title: This strategist’s bond-trading model is outperforming by a wide margin. The Fed slowing the economy is a good thing, he argues
stories.summary: Inflation and nominal growth have been way too high for too long, argues Michael Darda. Rather than criticizing the Fed for being hawkish, markets should applaud it and recommend it goes as far as necessary to slow demand.
stories.zh_title: 這位策略師的債券交易模型表現遠遠優於其他模型。他認為，聯準會放緩經濟是一件好事。
stories.zh_summary: Michael Darda 表示，通貨膨脹與名目成長率過高且持續太久。市場不應批評聯準會採取鷹派立場，反而應該對此表示讚許，並建議聯準會盡一切必要措施來抑制需求。

stories.title: AI debt worries grow as Nvidia rebound masks Big Tech spending squeeze
stories.summary: Big Tech could find it increasingly tough to secure funding from debt markets critical to the AI build-out, as lenders become pickier over corporate bonds.
stories.zh_title: 隨著輝達 (Nvidia) 的反彈掩蓋了大型科技公司的支出壓力，對人工智慧 (AI) 債務的擔憂日益加劇。
stories.zh_summary: 隨著放款人對公司債券的選擇變得更加挑剔，大型科技公司可能會發現越來越難從對人工智慧發展至關重要的債券市場獲得資金。

stories.title: Crypto talent will return ‘when AI implodes,’ Arthur Hayes says
stories.summary: Maelstrom CIO Arthur Hayes expects the AI trade to face headwinds in the second half of 2027, with startup talent potentially returning to crypto afterward.
stories.zh_title: Arthur Hayes 表示，當「人工智慧崩潰」時，加密貨幣人才將回歸
stories.zh_summary: Maelstrom 首席資訊長 Arthur Hayes 預計，人工智慧產業將在 2027 年下半年面臨逆風，之後新創企業的人才可能會回流到加密貨幣領域。

stories.title: Kylie Jenner again relists concrete mansion in L.A. for $38 million
stories.summary: Kylie Jenner’s fortress-like home is back on the market, this time with a fresh set of listing images—some of which have been enhanced by AI.
stories.zh_title: 凱莉·珍娜 (Kylie Jenner) 再度以 3,800 萬美元的價格出售位於洛杉磯的混凝土豪宅
stories.zh_summary: 凱莉·詹娜 (Kylie Jenner) 的堡壘式豪宅再次上市，這次附上了一系列全新的房源照片，其中一些經過 AI 強化處理。

stories.title: I hate that Jensen Huang is back at Nvidia, but I love what it’s done for my 401(k). Am I a hypocrite?
stories.summary: “I was paralyzed during the market downturn.”
stories.zh_title: 我很不喜歡黃仁勳重返輝達，但我很喜歡他為我的 401(k) 退休計畫所帶來的效益。我是不是個偽君子？
stories.zh_summary: 「在市場低迷時期，我感到不知所措。」

stories.title: AI is straining America’s open records systems
stories.summary: In Panton, Vermont, population 660, town clerk Kyle Rowe did it all. He crafted budgets, paid vendors, handled property tax disputes, and served as the town’s zoning supervisor and presiding elections officer. stories.zh_title: 人工智慧正在對美國的公開紀錄系統造成壓力
stories.zh_summary: 在佛蒙特州人口 660 人的潘頓鎮，鎮公所主任凱爾·羅伊 (Kyle Rowe) 一人身兼多職。他負責編列預算、支付廠商款項、處理財產稅爭議，並擔任鎮上的分區主管和選舉主持官。在鎮公所的上午辦公時間——這是一棟木質框架建築，於 19 世紀初建造，原為教堂，

stories.title: Jensen Huang's Nvidia return shows the U.S.-China AI race is about more than chips
stories.summary: Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO demonstrates that the U.S.-China artificial intelligence race is not just about semiconductors, but tech talent too.
stories.zh_title: 黃仁勳回歸英偉達表明中美人工智慧競賽不僅僅關乎晶片
stories.zh_summary: 黃仁勳重新出任英偉達執行長表明，中美人工智慧競賽不僅關乎半導體，也關乎科技人才。

stories.title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
stories.summary: Walmart now lets customers shop Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta’s AI agent.
stories.zh_title: 沃爾瑪與 Meta 合作，為人工智慧代理 Muse 帶來黑色星期五優惠
stories.zh_summary: 沃爾瑪現在允許客戶透過 Meta 的人工智慧代理 Muse 購買黑色星期五優惠。

stories.title: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
stories.summary: The startup's encrypted AI architecture is designed to prevent even the company itself from accessing users' private data.
stories.zh_title: Maple 籌集了 530 萬美元來開發人工智慧產品，這些產品可以保護您的數據，甚至可以保護您的數據
stories.zh_summary: 該新創公司的加密人工智慧架構旨在防止公司本身存取用戶的私人資料。

stories.title: How Meta is using Instagram to get an ad boost from its Muse personal AI agent
stories.summary: Meta doesn't serve ads in its Muse personal agent, but the tool is already boosting the company's ad business, a senior executive told CNBC.
stories.zh_title: Meta 如何利用 Instagram 的 Muse 個人人工智慧代理來提升廣告效果
stories.zh_summary: 一位高級管理人員告訴 CNBC，Meta 並未在其 Muse 個人代理中提供廣告服務，但該工具已經在推動該公司的廣告業務。

stories.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
stories.summary: Anthropic’s post-IPO slump could put pressure on AI startup valuations.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 股價跌破 IPO 價格，這對人工智慧新創公司來說是一個令人擔憂的跡象
stories.zh_summary: Anthropic 首次公開募股後的暴跌可能會對人工智慧新創公司的估值帶來壓力。

stories.title: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs
stories.summary: The new integration gets rid of the need for users to toggle between Instagram and the Muse app when they want to interact with the AI agent.
stories.zh_title: Meta 將其 Muse AI 助理直接引入 Instagram DM
stories.zh_summary: 新的整合使用戶在想要與 AI 代理互動時無需在 Instagram 和 Muse 應用程式之間切換。

stories.title: Jim Cramer says Tuesday's market pullback is an encouraging sign. Here's why
stories.summary: Jim Cramer said Tuesday's market action following Monday's massive rally is an encouraging sign that stocks are on the path to a more sustainable recovery.
stories.zh_title: 吉姆·克莱默表示，周二的市场回调是一个令人鼓舞的迹象。這就是為什麼
stories.zh_summary: 吉姆·克萊默表示，繼週一大幅上漲後，週二的市場走勢是一個令人鼓舞的跡象，表明股市正走上更永續的復甦之路。

stories.title: AI debt markets shudder as Nvidia's top 'banker' returns
stories.summary: Fears about some companies' AI debt ramped higher Tuesday, a day after Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO.
stories.zh_title: 英偉達頂級「銀行家」回歸，人工智慧債務市場顫抖
stories.zh_summary: 週二，黃仁勳重新擔任英偉達執行長的第二天，對一些公司人工智慧債務的擔憂加劇。

stories.title: Anthropic’s stock just broke below its IPO price for the first time
stories.summary: Shares are trading below their IPO price of $83, less than a week after their debut on the Nasdaq.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 的股價首度跌破 IPO 價格
stories.zh_summary: 該股在納斯達克上市不到一周，目前的交易價格低於 83 美元的 IPO 價格。

stories.title: Anthropic closes below $83 IPO price, but analysts are still largely positive
stories.summary: Anthropic has been sinking steadily since the stock opened at $111.50 on the Nasdaq on Nov. 19.
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 收盤價低於 83 美元 IPO 價格，但分析師仍基本持樂觀態度
stories.zh_summary: 自 11 月 19 日納斯達克股票開盤價為 111.50 美元以來，Anthropic 一直在穩步下跌。
